crossChecks.claim: By 1951-04-12 Matthew Ridgway had succeeded Douglas MacArthur as United Nations Commander in Korea

evidence.fact: Truman April11 order replaces MacArthur with Ridgway immediately
Morrison April11 states change of command and Ridgway new UN Commander

evidence.family: ROK presidential public statement transcribed from 1951 Ministry of Defense
evidence.fact: Rhee April12 recognizes Ridgway successor and welcomes appointment

crossChecks.limitations: Korean statement says 사임 whereas binding US order says 해임. Three institutional records but UK and ROK learned of US action from announcement, not three independent eyewitness observations.

crossChecks.claim: Security Council resolution 84 established a recommendation for a US-led unified command and requested US designation of its commander

evidence.fact: Resolution84 paragraphs 3-4 under United States, requests US commander designation
Morrison describes US as executive of unified command and president designation

evidence.family: US Joint Chiefs of Staff original
evidence.fact: May1 command directive recites July7 UN SC recommendation and operational delegation

crossChecks.limitations: UN resolution uses recommends/requests, not a freestanding unlimited authorization for all future military actions. UK and US statements rely on the same UN resolution; provenance separate but source dependence declared.

nonDuplication: Succession and 1950 legal basis are distinct atomic claims; do not count 3 more just by splitting same command event.
